stories.title: Gilmar Mendes decide que reajuste de Lula ao Bolsa Família 'não afronta' a lei eleitoral

en.title: Gilmar Mendes decides that Lula's Bolsa Família adjustment 'does not violate' electoral law
en.summary: A Brazilian Supreme Court justice ruled that the government's decree increasing Bolsa Família benefits according to inflation is legal and complies with a 2023 court order requiring such adjustments.

stories.title: Trump anuncia acordo com Dinamarca para ampliar presença militar na Groenlândia

en.title: Trump announces agreement with Denmark to expand US military presence in Greenland
en.summary: The US president stated he reached an agreement with Denmark to develop American military presence in Greenland while simultaneously seeking to prevent US adversaries from establishing bases there.

stories.title: Em decisão, Gilmar Mendes diz que reajuste do Bolsa Família feito por Lula não fere regras eleitorais

en.title: In ruling, Gilmar Mendes says Lula's Bolsa Família adjustment does not violate electoral rules
en.summary: A Brazilian Supreme Court minister determined that the decree raising Bolsa Família benefit values does not breach electoral regulations, describing the increase as a monetary correction adjustment.

stories.title: Trump diz que fechou acordo com a Dinamarca e EUA terão controle sobre segurança da Groenlândia

en.title: Trump says he closed deal with Denmark and US will have control over Greenland's security
en.summary: The US president stated that an agreement with Denmark has been reached granting American control over Greenland's security matters.

stories.title: AGU pede que STF reconheça validade do reajuste do Bolsa Família

en.title: AGU asks STF to recognize validity of Bolsa Família adjustment
en.summary: Brazil's Attorney General's Office requested the Supreme Court to validate a presidential decree authorizing a 15 percent increase to Bolsa Família benefits starting October 1st, with minimum payments rising to 691 reais.

stories.title: Ex-vereador Milton Leite se entrega à polícia após operação contra PCC

en.title: Former councilman Milton Leite surrenders to police after operation against PCC
en.summary: Ex-councilman and former president of São Paulo's City Council Milton Leite, from União Brasil party, turned himself in to police following an operation investigating the PCC's involvement in public transportation.

stories.title: Trump proíbe acesso à Casa Branca de veículos de imprensa críticos ao governo

en.title: Trump bans access of critical press vehicles to White House
en.summary: President Donald Trump announced restrictions on White House access for several news outlets, including CNN, Politico, and MSNOW, accusing them of publishing false reports and suggesting additional media bans may follow.

stories.title: Trump proíbe acesso da CNN, do MSNOW e do Politico à Casa Branca e ameaça outros veículos

en.title: Trump bans CNN, MSNOW and Politico access to White House and threatens other outlets
en.summary: President Trump restricted White House access for CNN, MSNOW, and Politico while indicating additional media outlets may face similar restrictions.

stories.title: Gilmar decide que reajuste do Bolsa Família não fere regras eleitorais

en.title: Gilmar decides that Bolsa Família increase does not violate electoral rules
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes ruled that the Bolsa Família benefit increase announced by the Lula government does not breach electoral regulations.

stories.title: MP junto ao TCU pede suspensão de reajuste do Bolsa Família

en.title: Public Ministry requests suspension of Bolsa Família increase
en.summary: The Public Ministry office at the Court of Accounts of the Union sought to suspend the Bolsa Família benefit increase announced by the Lula government.

stories.title: Trump proíbe acesso à Casa Branca de CNN, MSNOW e Politico

en.title: Trump bans CNN, MSNBC and Politico from White House access
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced restrictions preventing CNN, MSNBC and Politico from accessing the White House, occurring weeks before legislative elections.

stories.title: Após prisão, defesa diz que Milton Leite está 'absolutamente tranquilo'

en.title: After arrest, Milton Leite's defense says he is 'absolutely calm'
en.summary: The defense of arrested former São Paulo city councilman and ex-chamber president Milton Leite stated he has no connection to an investigation into alleged PCC involvement in the city's public transportation sector.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest no RJ testa apoios de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro ao governo em 2026

en.title: New Quaest survey in RJ tests support for Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of 2026 government elections
en.summary: A Quaest poll in Rio de Janeiro will measure voting intentions for state governor and Senate races in 2026, surveying 1,302 voters between September 19-22. Results will be released on September 23 and include eight gubernatorial candidates and two runoff scenarios.

stories.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest em Pernambuco medirá disputa pelo governo e Senado

en.title: New Quaest survey in Pernambuco to measure dispute for government and Senate
en.summary: A Quaest poll in Pernambuco will measure voting intentions for state governor and Senate elections in 2026, surveying 1,302 voters between September 19-22. The results will be released on September 23 with seven gubernatorial candidates assessed in the first round.

stories.title: MPT processa influenciador Rico Melquíades por assédio eleitoral

en.title: Labor Ministry sues influencer Rico Melquíades for electoral harassment
en.summary: Brazil's Labor Ministry filed a lawsuit against digital influencer Rico Melquíades in Alagoas for allegedly coercing domestic workers through electoral harassment. The suit seeks 5 million reais in collective damages and compliance with 18 workplace-related obligations.

stories.title: Aneel eleva projeção de alta da conta de luz em 2026

en.title: Aneel raises projection for electricity bill increase in 2026
en.summary: Brazil's electrical regulatory agency raised its 2026 electricity tariff projection from 8.6 percent to 9.4 percent, exceeding expected inflation rates. The agency had previously increased its estimate from 8 percent to 8.6 percent in June.

stories.title: Trump diz que chegou a acordo com Dinamarca e Groenlândia sobre controle dos EUA na segurança da ilha

en.title: Trump says he reached agreement with Denmark and Greenland on US control of island security
en.summary: US President Donald Trump announced a trilateral agreement giving the United States permanent control over security and other matters in Greenland. Trump stated the arrangement ensures the US capacity to take necessary actions to protect Greenland and American security.
